snippet.title: Blood Accord – Official Trailer (ENG)
snippet.description:
Welcome to Blood Accord, the visual novel where your choices matter... mostly in how spectacularly things go wrong. 

Help the main character unravel the mystery of the terrifying public restroom from her dreams. Get ready to browse websites, delve into her old notes, and fight off internet trolls. 
Hurry! With only five days remaining, she's on the brink of madness.

Wishlist Blood Accord on Steam so you don't miss the release!
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3484040/Blood_Accord/
